summary: IT-Tools is a web-based collection of utilities designed for developers and system administrators. It groups common conversion, encoding, generation, and formatting functions into a single interface. The project is a community-maintained fork of the original it-tools repository.
goodFor: A good fit if you want a self-hosted alternative to public online utility websites for your internal team or personal lab.
watchOut: It duplicates functionality easily found in command-line tools, browser extensions, or existing single-purpose web apps.
deployNotes: It typically deploys as a stateless container using Docker, meaning you only need to configure port mapping and a reverse proxy for HTTPS.
